check: Depth maps + dense cloud on a project reconstructed AFTER the centre-aligned pixel convention change (2026-10-06)
pass_criteria: first-image GPU validate RMS < 5e-3 as before; dense point count and fusion kept-fraction within a few % of the last recorded run; no visible half-pixel seam between depth maps
notes: Unit tests pin scaleK against native projection; no dense bench exists

dataset: any (ideally a GPU run and a WASM run)
check: Build Depth Maps at the default log level: cross-view filter visibility + progress split
pass_criteria: a 'Depth filter: cross-view check over N maps' line, then one info line per map, during the filter; the bar keeps moving within a map; the closing 'cross-view consistency in …s (… µs/px; X% of Stage A, progress bar gave it Y%)' has X and Y within ~2× of each other - record both and the µs/px to retune DENSE_TUNING.geomFilterUsPerPx

pass_criteria: the mesh is the eagle plus at most a few small pieces; no closed floater blobs; gray-fallback vertex share in the log < 5 %; meshSummary names the cleaned cloud

dataset: an aerial set with a dense cloud (building / South Building)
check: Build Mesh at default settings; compare with a pre-2026-10-07 mesh of the same cloud if one exists
pass_criteria: no new holes in the well-observed surface; the mesh-surface ortho (PRD-01) still has a dense mask

dataset: any project with a computed and a derived dense cloud

pass_criteria: the modal Source line names the derived cloud; the log and meshSummary confirm it was the one meshed
